text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and some stretching. After a quick shower and breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work at a computer for most of the day, but I always take short breaks to stay focused. In the afternoon, I go to the gym or go running for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read a book before bed. I try to keep this routine every day because consistency helps me feel healthy and calm.
